tagline.en: Give AI agents long-term memory without making users repeat themselves.
tagline.zh: 让 AI Agent 记住用户，而不是让用户反复介绍自己。

summary.en: memware is a local-first long-term memory layer for MCP-compatible agents. It distills conversations into durable, searchable memory and recalls relevant context in later tasks. Memory stays on the user's machine, while extraction and embedding use the OpenAI-compatible model endpoint the user chooses.
summary.zh: memware 是面向 MCP 兼容 Agent 的本地优先长期记忆层。它把对话提炼为持久、可搜索的记忆，并在后续任务中召回相关上下文。记忆保存在用户自己的设备上，提取与向量化使用用户选择的 OpenAI 兼容模型接口。

body.en: A Claude Code Stop Hook captures each completed turn, so persistence does not depend on the model remembering to call a tool.
body.zh: Claude Code Stop Hook 在每轮结束后自动捕获对话，不依赖模型记得调用写入工具。

body.en: Seven MCP tools cover status, warmup, context retrieval, processing, search, archive, and reset.
body.zh: 7 个 MCP 工具覆盖状态、预热、上下文召回、处理、搜索、归档与重置。

body.en: Structured memory, vector indexes, and audit logs live under a local data directory.
body.zh: 结构化记忆、向量索引和审计日志都保存在本地数据目录。

body.en: Extraction and embeddings use configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoints instead of a single locked provider.
body.zh: 提取与 Embedding 使用可配置的 OpenAI 兼容接口，不绑定单一模型供应商。

result.en: Keep project constraints, personal preferences, and prior decisions available across sessions.
result.zh: 跨会话保留项目约束、个人偏好与历史决策。

result.en: Recover relevant context in a new session instead of restating the same background.
result.zh: 新会话能够找回相关上下文，减少重复说明。

result.en: Bind one local service process to one trusted tenant and reject caller-selected identities.
result.zh: 一个本地服务进程只绑定一个可信租户，并拒绝调用方切换身份。

result.en: Let a trusted downstream map authenticated sessions to isolated tenant capabilities without accepting caller-selected identities.
result.zh: 由可信下游把已认证会话映射为隔离的租户能力，不接受调用方自行选择身份。

result.en: Let users search, audit, and erase the memory they own.
result.zh: 让用户搜索、审计并删除自己持有的记忆。
